title: Cale88 reduced employees due to non-operation, change of management -- DTI witness
summary: Cale88 had reduced its number of employees from 2024 to 2025 due to a change in ownership, according to a defense witness from the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) on Friday.

blocks.text: Cale88 reduced the number of employees from 2024 to 2025 due to a change in ownership, according to a defense witness from the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) on Friday.
The food corporation was linked to Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband Manases Carpio, and had previously been flagged for having only two employees while generating P150 million in sales.

On the 45th day of Duterte’s impeachment trial, DTI Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo of DTI’s Industry Development and Investment Promotions Group presented several documents regarding Cale88, one of which was a Plant Inspection Report.

The Plant Inspection Report detailed a visit by DTI Board of Investment (BOI) officials to Cale88 on May 18, 2026. It listed the company’s new owners as of 2026, namely a certain Lolita Paimalan as President, Chris Chiu as Legal Officer, and Leo Sacurom as a Compliance Officer.
“Ito po yung mga bagong may-ari, bagong presidente nung Cale88 Foods Corporation,” Rodolfo said.
(These are the new owners, the new president of Cale88 Foods Corporation.)

“During the inspection, the firm's compliance with its terms and conditions has been discussed, particularly, its direct labor commitment. For 2025, which is Year 3, the firm had to maintain direct labor of 39. Yun po kasi yung nakalagay doon sa kanyang specific terms and conditions na cinommit po sa atin sa gobyerno. But based on the 2025 BOI Form S-1, the firm had an actual labor of 50 while in 2024 they had reported 201,” Roldolfo said, reading the report.

“In response to the inquiry on the reduction of the number of labor from 2024 to 2025, the firm explained that it was attributable to a period of non-operation in 2025 due to the change in management and ownership,” he added.

Rodolfo explained that a change of ownership should be reported to the BOI. This report should include previous and current ownership structures, as well as the General Information Sheets before and after the change.

According to a separate DTI report titled “Report on Actual Date of Start of Commercial Operations, Initial Investments and Employment”, Cale88 officially began operations on January 1, 2023. It had 117 direct laborers and one person in admin and sales. —VAL, GMA News
